title: I built a free directory for AI-made multiplayer games to help them find players
author: Frequent-Motor-492
selftext:
I make multiplayer games with AI tools, and getting players has been my biggest problem.

So I built **DeepPlaylist** ([deepplaylist.com](https://deepplaylist.com/)), a directory just for AI-made online multiplayer games: real-time, turn-based or persistent worlds.

**What it offers developers:**

* **Free listings.** Submit your link and a cover image, and each submission is reviewed by hand.
* **Players go to your site.** Nothing is hosted or embedded, so the players and traffic are yours.
* **A page for your game.** It links back to your site and shows how many clicks your game gets.
* **Easier to find.** Players can filter by game type, by mobile or desktop, and by tags.

**What gets listed:** games that are actually multiplayer with a backend you run, hosted on your own domain. Links to [itch.io](http://itch.io), Vercel, GitHub Pages and similar hosts aren't accepted.

The catalog is still small, so early listings will be easy to spot. If you have a multiplayer game, you can [submit it here](https://deepplaylist.com/submit). I'd also like feedback on what would make the site more useful to you, and on whether the own-domain rule is too strict.
